h1: MIA Airport Car Service | Onyx Executive Miami
a1: Private black-SUV transfers to and from Miami International Airport (MIA). Flight tracking, meet-and-greet, fixed quote confirmed before you land.
l7: Where exactly at MIA do you meet arriving passengers?
l8: Curbside at the arrivals level by default, or a meet-and-greet point just past baggage claim if you'd rather not manage bags to the curb alone — confirmed with you when you book, not decided on the day.
l9: What happens if my flight is delayed or lands early?
l10: Your chauffeur tracks the flight in real time and adjusts the pickup window automatically. Early or late, the fixed quote you were given at booking doesn't change.
l11: Do you serve MIA for connecting cruise passengers?
l12: Yes. MIA-to-PortMiami and MIA-to-Port Everglades transfers are booked the same way as any airport run, timed against your ship's boarding window rather than a generic drive-time estimate.
l13: Is there room for golf clubs or extra luggage from MIA?
l14: The Suburban RST seats up to six with luggage capacity confirmed before booking based on passenger count, bag count, and anything oversized like golf clubs or strollers.
l15: Can I book a one-way MIA transfer and a separate return later?
l16: Yes. Most bookings are one-way pickups or drop-offs; round-trip and standing return dates are arranged just as easily on the same fixed-quote basis.
h5: Flight-tracked black-SUV pickups at Miami International — curbside for domestic arrivals, past customs for international, with your chauffeur staged and confirmed on arrival.

h9: MIA's terminal layout and pickup zones change by airline and concourse. Your flight is tracked from wheels-down, and your chauffeur confirms pickup once you're through the process for your arrival type:
h10: Domestic arrivals — met curbside at baggage claim, typically the faster of the two.
h11: International arrivals — met past customs and baggage; the extra processing time is tracked and built into the pickup plan, not treated as a delay.
h13: MIA–Aventura/Sunny Isles typically runs 30-40 minutes outside peak hours. MIA–Brickell and Downtown run closer to 20-25 minutes. MIA–PortMiami for a same-day cruise connection runs roughly 15-20 minutes. Exact timing confirmed at booking based on your destination.
h15: Every MIA transfer is quoted at a fixed price before the trip, tolls and standard wait time included. No surge pricing, no reassigned driver mid-trip.
